title: Design System Daniel Shayo Engineering Portfolio

narrative.overview: An evidence-first engineering portfolio where projects read as inspected records and implementation remains distinct from ambition.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime is reserved for availability and active-development state.

rules.name: The Evidence Voice Rule
rules.body: Large type states purpose; small mono type identifies evidence.

dos: Lead with real project imagery and working links.
Distinguish current implementation from future development.
donts: Do not wrap every section in rounded cards.
Do not invent adoption, performance, or production claims.
